figurative_meaning_en: To punish or beat an innocent person
similar_in_english: Taking it out on the wrong person
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার রাগের মাথায় সে নির্দোষ ভাইকে ব্যাঙ খোঁচালো।
অফিসের ভুলের জন্য বস নির্দোষ কর্মীকে ব্যাঙ খোঁচানোর মতো শাস্তি দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: In his anger, he took it out on his innocent brother like poking a frog.
The boss punished the innocent employee for the office mistake, akin to beating an undeserving frog.
note: The idiom draws from rural imagery of frogs in ponds, symbolizing harmless creatures being unnecessarily harmed.
